fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Answers routed to one named person

Write a rule for any answer staff must act on, such as an allergy or a missing referral. The app messages that person in Slack, by email, or in the app, and logs who was told.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Before Tuesday, a latex allergy reaches the surgical assistant

Saoirse Ebbesen is booked for a tooth extraction at Hollins Creek Oral Surgery on Tuesday at 8:00 a.m. On Sunday at 7:12 p.m., she answers yes to the latex allergy question. The app sends a direct message to Ysella Quellet, Tuesday's surgical assistant, and flags latex on the day sheet.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { intakeReminders: "Email every new patient an intake link the moment they book. Two days before the visit, email a reminder to anyone who has not finished. At 4 p.m. the day before, send the front desk lead a call list of the intakes still open, with each patient's visit time and phone number, earliest visit first.", insuranceCards: "Ask each patient to photograph the front and back of their insurance card during intake. Read the plan name, group number, and member ID from the front of the card. If the member ID read from the card does not match the one the patient typed, hold the intake for my billing coordinator to check before the visit.", allergyAlerts: "Add a latex allergy question to the intake for every procedure visit. When a patient answers yes, send a direct message to the surgical assistant on that day's schedule with the patient's name and visit time, and add a latex flag next to the patient on the day sheet.", duplicateRecords: "Send each finished intake to my scheduling system through its API as a new patient record. If the last name and date of birth match an existing patient, hold the intake in a merge queue for my records lead instead of creating a record. Show each day's count of new records and held intakes." };
fieldData.alpb---prompt: Build patient intake automation for my dermatology practice that emails each new patient an intake link when they book.
